rows.title: marketing campaigns handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] marketing campaigns records verified in status "planned" must be moved to status "draft". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: marketing campaigns handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For marketing campaigns records verified in status "planned": if the record's owner_employee_id is "5", move it to status "active"; otherwise move it to status "draft". Apply exactly one transition.
